facts.fact: The Space Science and Geospatial Institute's project manager says the Ethiopian Digital Addressing System is implemented in its entirety in Bishoftu, where every house has a unique 10-digit digital address.
The project manager says address assignment in Adama is complete with data entry nearly done, and an agreement has been reached to implement the system in Addis Ababa.

ETH.note: Nothing on consultation on a digital law or policy.
